notes.title: Heroic Assault is now available!
notes.content:
Today's the day!

Heroic Assault is now available on Steam, with a 10% launch discount for the first week.

I hope you will enjoy the game and look forward to reading your feedback.

Cheers,

notes.title: Quality of life updates in the demo
notes.content:
There is less than one week before the release of Heroic Assault!

I am working on some minor tweaks and quality of life updates to improve player experience, after some feedback from the demo.
[list]
[*] The unit shortcuts at the bottom of the screen have been reworked to be more aligned with what can be done in RTS games. The key mapping has been moved to the 1-9 keys and groups are now matching the wave structure, allowing to selected units with more details and be more efficient!
[*] Left clicking on a defense will now show a bit of information about it, so you know what you are dealing with with more details.
[*] Quality settings have been fine tuned and the disk size has been optimized
[/list]

All of those changes are available in the demo, which will stay live until the day before release!

notes.title: The demo of Heroic Assault is now available!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

The demo for Heroic Assault has just been released and is ready for you to test!
You will have access to the first levels of the game to get a better idea of the gameplay.

Feel free to share your impressions, suggestions, and potential bug reports on the community hub.

Cheers,

notes.title: New languages supported for launch
notes.content:
The translation process has started in order to support new languages right on launch!

In addition to English, Chinese, Russian, and French will be supported at the game's launch.
